title: Check if Matrix Is X-Matrix
summary: Determine if a square matrix is an X-Matrix by ensuring all diagonal elements are non-zero and all non-diagonal elements are zero.
statement: Determine if a square matrix is an X-Matrix by ensuring all diagonal elements are non-zero and all non-diagonal elements are zero.
constraints: Both main diagonals must contain only nonzero values.
Every cell outside those diagonals must equal zero.
hints: A cell lies on the main diagonal when row equals column.
It lies on the other diagonal when row+column equals n-1.
Require nonzero on either diagonal and zero everywhere else.
These predicates partition all cells, so checking each cell proves both X-matrix conditions.
editorial: These predicates partition all cells, so checking each cell proves both X-matrix conditions.

tests.explanation: Every diagonal entry is nonzero and all other entries are zero.
In a two-by-two grid every cell is diagonal, but the bottom-right cell is zero.
